subject: executor: reserve memory for rawData in hash join (#63744)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on executor hash join v2. The change shifts row-table segment construction to per-chunk segments with upfront capacity preallocation and memory-tracker consumption (including rawData), removes segment finalization bookkeeping, and adjusts spill/memory-usage accounting accordingly (plus adds `chunk.Row.GetRawLen`/`Column.GetRawLength` to avoid materializing raw bytes for length computation). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics, data consistency, concurrency/spill coordination, or runtime/protocol handling within the touched executor codepaths.
